name: Deore XT direct-mount double front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 127 g for the exact FD-M785-E2 direct-mount double-front assembly. The manufacturer explicitly identifies this model as direct mount; no band size is selected and the neighbouring clamp-model weight is not substituted.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2015 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 26: XT SL-M780-B-I I-spec complete pair 220 g; manufacturer explicitly calls FD-M785-E2 and FD-M786-D direct mount and assigns 127 g / 146 g respectively
